@@ -0,0 +1,389 @@
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { queryKey } from '@tanstack/query-test-utils'
+import {
+  InfiniteQueryObserver,
+  QueryCache,
+  QueryClient,
+  QueryObserver,
+  createPersisterRestoreResult,
+  isPersisterRestoreResult,
+  reconcileQueryState,
+} from '..'
+import type { QueryState } from '..'
+
+describe('persister restore', () => {
+  let queryClient: QueryClient
+  let queryCache: QueryCache
+  const onSuccess = vi.fn()
+  const onSettled = vi.fn()
+
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers()
+    onSuccess.mockClear()
+    onSettled.mockClear()
+    queryCache = new QueryCache({ onSuccess, onSettled })
+    queryClient = new QueryClient({ queryCache })
+  })
+
+  afterEach(() => {
+    vi.useRealTimers()
+    queryClient.clear()
+  })
+
+  describe('createPersisterRestoreResult helper', () => {
+    test('creates a valid restore result marker', () => {
+      const state: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'persisted data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+        dataUpdateCount: 1,
+        error: new Error('persisted error'),
+        errorUpdatedAt: 2000,
+        errorUpdateCount: 1,
+        fetchFailureCount: 2,
+        fetchFailureReason: new Error('persisted error'),
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: true,
+        status: 'error',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const result = createPersisterRestoreResult({
+        data: 'persisted data',
+        state,
+      })
+
+      expect(isPersisterRestoreResult(result)).toBe(true)
+      expect(result.data).toBe('persisted data')
+      expect(result.state).toBe(state)
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('prefetchQuery with restored snapshot', () => {
+    test('adopts provided state, preserves refetch-error and does not call onSuccess/onSettled', async () => {
+      const key = queryKey()
+      const persistedError = new Error('persisted refetch error')
+
+      const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'cached data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+        dataUpdateCount: 3,
+        error: persistedError,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 2000,
+        errorUpdateCount: 1,
+        fetchFailureCount: 4,
+        fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: true,
+        status: 'error',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      await queryClient.prefetchQuery({
+        queryKey: key,
+        queryFn: () => 'fresh data',
+        persister: () =>
+          createPersisterRestoreResult({
+            data: persistedState.data,
+            state: persistedState,
+          }),
+      })
+
+      const query = queryCache.find({ queryKey: key })!
+      expect(query).toBeDefined()
+
+      // Active state adopted
+      expect(query.state.data).toBe('cached data')
+      expect(query.state.status).toBe('error')
+      expect(query.state.error).toBe(persistedError)
+      expect(query.state.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+      expect(query.state.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(1000)
+      expect(query.state.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+      expect(query.state.fetchFailureCount).toBe(4)
+      expect(query.state.fetchFailureReason).toBe(persistedError)
+      expect(query.state.dataUpdateCount).toBe(3)
+      expect(query.state.errorUpdateCount).toBe(1)
+      expect(query.state.isInvalidated).toBe(true)
+
+      // Fetch success callbacks must NOT have been called
+      expect(onSuccess).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+      expect(onSettled).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+
+      // Observer on the adopted query exposes isRefetchError
+      const observer = new QueryObserver(queryClient, { queryKey: key })
+      const result = observer.getCurrentResult()
+
+      expect(result.status).toBe('error')
+      expect(result.isError).toBe(true)
+      expect(result.isRefetchError).toBe(true)
+      expect(result.failureCount).toBe(4)
+      expect(result.failureReason).toBe(persistedError)
+      expect(result.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(1000)
+      expect(result.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+      expect(result.isStale).toBe(true)
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('query observers with persister', () => {
+    test('restores snapshot during observer execution and exposes full metadata without fresh recomputations', async () => {
+      const key = queryKey()
+      const persistedError = new Error('persisted error')
+
+      const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'cached data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 5000,
+        dataUpdateCount: 1,
+        error: persistedError,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 6000,
+        errorUpdateCount: 2,
+        fetchFailureCount: 3,
+        fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: false,
+        status: 'error',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const observer = new QueryObserver(queryClient, {
+        queryKey: key,
+        queryFn: () => 'network data',
+        persister: () =>
+          createPersisterRestoreResult({
+            data: persistedState.data,
+            state: persistedState,
+          }),
+      })
+
+      const results: Array<any> = []
+      const unsubscribe = observer.subscribe((res) => {
+        results.push(res)
+      })
+
+      await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(10)
+
+      const query = queryCache.find({ queryKey: key })!
+      expect(query.state.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+      expect(query.state.status).toBe('error')
+      expect(query.state.data).toBe('cached data')
+      expect(query.state.error).toBe(persistedError)
+      expect(query.state.fetchFailureCount).toBe(3)
+      expect(query.state.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(5000)
+      expect(query.state.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(6000)
+
+      // Observer exposed result
+      const current = observer.getCurrentResult()
+      expect(current.data).toBe('cached data')
+      expect(current.status).toBe('error')
+      expect(current.isRefetchError).toBe(true)
+      expect(current.failureCount).toBe(3)
+      expect(current.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(5000)
+      expect(current.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(6000)
+      expect(current.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+
+      // Callbacks not fired
+      expect(onSuccess).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+      expect(onSettled).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+
+      unsubscribe()
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('infinite queries with persister', () => {
+    test('preserves pagination state including pages and pageParams', async () => {
+      const key = queryKey()
+      const persistedData = {
+        pages: ['page 1', 'page 2'],
+        pageParams: [1, 2],
+      }
+
+      const persistedState: QueryState<typeof persistedData, Error> = {
+        data: persistedData,
+        dataUpdatedAt: 1234,
+        dataUpdateCount: 2,
+        error: null,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+        errorUpdateCount: 0,
+        fetchFailureCount: 0,
+        fetchFailureReason: null,
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: false,
+        status: 'success',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      await queryClient.prefetchInfiniteQuery({
+        queryKey: key,
+        queryFn: ({ pageParam }) => `network page ${pageParam}`,
+        initialPageParam: 1,
+        getNextPageParam: (_lastPage: string, allPages: Array<string>) =>
+          allPages.length + 1,
+        persister: () =>
+          createPersisterRestoreResult({
+            data: persistedState.data,
+            state: persistedState,
+          }),
+      })
+
+      const query = queryCache.find({ queryKey: key })!
+      expect(query.state.data).toEqual({
+        pages: ['page 1', 'page 2'],
+        pageParams: [1, 2],
+      })
+      expect(query.state.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(1234)
+
+      // Subscribe and verify observer result retains pages and pageParams
+      const observer = new InfiniteQueryObserver(queryClient, {
+        queryKey: key,
+        queryFn: ({ pageParam }) => `network page ${pageParam}`,
+        initialPageParam: 1,
+        getNextPageParam: (_lastPage: string, allPages: Array<string>) =>
+          allPages.length + 1,
+      })
+
+      const res = observer.getCurrentResult()
+      expect(res.data?.pages).toEqual(['page 1', 'page 2'])
+      expect(res.data?.pageParams).toEqual([1, 2])
+    })
+  })
+
+  describe('reconcileQueryState', () => {
+    test('live cache has newer data but persisted snapshot has newer error metadata', () => {
+      const liveState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'new live data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 3000,
+        dataUpdateCount: 2,
+        error: null,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+        errorUpdateCount: 0,
+        fetchFailureCount: 0,
+        fetchFailureReason: null,
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: false,
+        status: 'success',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const persistedError = new Error('persisted newer error')
+      const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'old persisted data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+        dataUpdateCount: 1,
+        error: persistedError,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 4000,
+        errorUpdateCount: 1,
+        fetchFailureCount: 2,
+        fetchFailureReason: persistedError,
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: true,
+        status: 'error',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const reconciled = reconcileQueryState(liveState, persistedState)
+
+      // Keeps newer data from live
+      expect(reconciled.data).toBe('new live data')
+      expect(reconciled.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(3000)
+      expect(reconciled.dataUpdateCount).toBe(2)
+
+      // Adopts newer error from persisted
+      expect(reconciled.error).toBe(persistedError)
+      expect(reconciled.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(4000)
+      expect(reconciled.fetchFailureCount).toBe(2)
+      expect(reconciled.fetchFailureReason).toBe(persistedError)
+
+      // Result remains a refetch error
+      expect(reconciled.status).toBe('error')
+      expect(reconciled.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+      expect(reconciled.isInvalidated).toBe(true)
+    })
+
+    test('persisted snapshot has newer data but live cache has newer error metadata', () => {
+      const liveError = new Error('live newer error')
+      const liveState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'old live data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+        dataUpdateCount: 1,
+        error: liveError,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 4000,
+        errorUpdateCount: 2,
+        fetchFailureCount: 3,
+        fetchFailureReason: liveError,
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: false,
+        status: 'error',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'newer persisted data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 3000,
+        dataUpdateCount: 2,
+        error: null,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+        errorUpdateCount: 0,
+        fetchFailureCount: 0,
+        fetchFailureReason: null,
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: false,
+        status: 'success',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const reconciled = reconcileQueryState(liveState, persistedState)
+
+      // Newer data is not discarded because of newer error timestamp
+      expect(reconciled.data).toBe('newer persisted data')
+      expect(reconciled.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(3000)
+
+      // Newer error from live is retained
+      expect(reconciled.error).toBe(liveError)
+      expect(reconciled.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(4000)
+      expect(reconciled.fetchFailureCount).toBe(3)
+
+      // Result remains a refetch error
+      expect(reconciled.status).toBe('error')
+      expect(reconciled.fetchStatus).toBe('idle')
+    })
+
+    test('live newer data with persisted newer error metadata remains a refetch error', () => {
+      const liveState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'fresh live data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 5000,
+        dataUpdateCount: 2,
+        error: null,
+        errorUpdatedAt: 0,
+        errorUpdateCount: 0,
+        fetchFailureCount: 0,
+        fetchFailureReason: null,
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: false,
+        status: 'success',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const persistedState: QueryState<string, Error> = {
+        data: 'old persisted data',
+        dataUpdatedAt: 1000,
+        dataUpdateCount: 1,
+        error: new Error('old error'),
+        errorUpdatedAt: 2000,
+        errorUpdateCount: 1,
+        fetchFailureCount: 1,
+        fetchFailureReason: new Error('old error'),
+        fetchMeta: null,
+        isInvalidated: false,
+        status: 'error',
+        fetchStatus: 'idle',
+      }
+
+      const reconciled = reconcileQueryState(liveState, persistedState)
+
+      expect(reconciled.data).toBe('fresh live data')
+      expect(reconciled.dataUpdatedAt).toBe(5000)
+      expect(reconciled.status).toBe('error')
+      expect(reconciled.error?.message).toBe('old error')
+      expect(reconciled.errorUpdatedAt).toBe(2000)
+      expect(reconciled.fetchFailureCount).toBe(1)
+    })
+  })
+})

+import type { DefaultError, QueryStatus } from './types'
+import type { QueryState } from './query'
+
+export const persisterRestoreMarker = Symbol.for(
+  '@tanstack/query-core/persisterRestoreMarker',
+)
+
+export interface PersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+> {
+  [persisterRestoreMarker]: true
+  __persisterRestore?: true
+  data?: TData
+  state?: QueryState<TData, TError>
+}
+
+/**
+ * Creates a marker result indicating that a persisted query snapshot was restored
+ * instead of freshly fetched.
+ */
+export function createPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(result: {
+  data?: TData
+  state?: QueryState<TData, TError>
+}): PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return {
+    [persisterRestoreMarker]: true,
+    __persisterRestore: true,
+    data: result.data,
+    state: result.state,
+  }
+}
+
+export function isPersisterRestoreResult<
+  TData = unknown,
+  TError = DefaultError,
+>(value: unknown): value is PersisterRestoreResult<TData, TError> {
+  return (
+    value != null &&
+    typeof value === 'object' &&
+    (persisterRestoreMarker in value ||
+      (value as any).__persisterRestore === true)
+  )
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reconciles an existing in-memory query state with a persisted snapshot.
+ * Merges data freshness and error freshness independently.
+ */
+export function reconcileQueryState<TData = unknown, TError = DefaultError>(
+  liveState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+  persistedState: QueryState<TData, TError>,
+): QueryState<TData, TError> {
+  const liveDataUpdatedAt = liveState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+  const persistedDataUpdatedAt = persistedState.dataUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  let data: TData | undefined
+  let dataUpdatedAt: number
+  let dataUpdateCount: number
+
+  if (liveState.data !== undefined && persistedState.data === undefined) {
+    data = liveState.data
+    dataUpdatedAt = liveDataUpdatedAt
+    dataUpdateCount = liveState.dataUpdateCount
+  } else if (persistedState.data !== undefined && liveState.data === undefined) {
+    data = persistedState.data
+    dataUpdatedAt = persistedDataUpdatedAt
+    dataUpdateCount = persistedState.dataUpdateCount
+  } else if (persistedDataUpdatedAt > liveDataUpdatedAt) {
+    data = persistedState.data
+    dataUpdatedAt = persistedDataUpdatedAt
+    dataUpdateCount = persistedState.dataUpdateCount
+  } else {
+    data = liveState.data !== undefined ? liveState.data : persistedState.data
+    dataUpdatedAt =
+      liveDataUpdatedAt > 0 ? liveDataUpdatedAt : persistedDataUpdatedAt
+    dataUpdateCount = Math.max(
+      liveState.dataUpdateCount,
+      persistedState.dataUpdateCount,
+    )
+  }
+
+  const liveErrorUpdatedAt = liveState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+  const persistedErrorUpdatedAt = persistedState.errorUpdatedAt ?? 0
+
+  let error: TError | null
+  let errorUpdatedAt: number
+  let errorUpdateCount: number
+  let fetchFailureCount: number
+  let fetchFailureReason: TError | null
+
+  if (persistedErrorUpdatedAt > liveErrorUpdatedAt) {
+    error = persistedState.error
+    errorUpdatedAt = persistedErrorUpdatedAt
+    errorUpdateCount = persistedState.errorUpdateCount
+    fetchFailureCount = persistedState.fetchFailureCount
+    fetchFailureReason = persistedState.fetchFailureReason
+  } else if (liveErrorUpdatedAt > persistedErrorUpdatedAt) {
+    error = liveState.error
+    errorUpdatedAt = liveErrorUpdatedAt
+    errorUpdateCount = liveState.errorUpdateCount
+    fetchFailureCount = liveState.fetchFailureCount
+    fetchFailureReason = liveState.fetchFailureReason
+  } else {
+    if (persistedState.error != null && liveState.error == null) {
+      error = persistedState.error
+      errorUpdatedAt = persistedErrorUpdatedAt
+      errorUpdateCount = persistedState.errorUpdateCount
+      fetchFailureCount = persistedState.fetchFailureCount
+      fetchFailureReason = persistedState.fetchFailureReason
+    } else {
+      error = liveState.error ?? persistedState.error ?? null
+      errorUpdatedAt = liveErrorUpdatedAt || persistedErrorUpdatedAt || 0
+      errorUpdateCount = Math.max(
+        liveState.errorUpdateCount,
+        persistedState.errorUpdateCount,
+      )
+      fetchFailureCount = Math.max(
+        liveState.fetchFailureCount,
+        persistedState.fetchFailureCount,
+      )
+      fetchFailureReason =
+        liveState.fetchFailureReason ??
+        persistedState.fetchFailureReason ??
+        null
+    }
+  }
+
+  let status: QueryStatus
+
+  if (error != null) {
+    status = 'error'
+  } else if (data !== undefined) {
+    status = 'success'
+  } else {
+    status = persistedState.status ?? liveState.status ?? 'pending'
+  }
+
+  return {
+    data,
+    dataUpdatedAt,
+    dataUpdateCount,
+    error,
+    errorUpdatedAt,
+    errorUpdateCount,
+    fetchFailureCount,
+    fetchFailureReason,
+    fetchMeta: liveState.fetchMeta ?? persistedState.fetchMeta ?? null,
+    isInvalidated: Boolean(
+      liveState.isInvalidated || persistedState.isInvalidated,
+    ),
+    status,
+    fetchStatus: 'idle',
+  }
+}
